verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for EFTPS because it holds user payment records, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that users can view 15 months of payment history. Nothing documents exporting that data, any open file format, or a full account-data takeout, and viewing history online is an adjacent feature, not export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
